creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen once 2026-11-11 in a full gate at load 21 (a --ssh tier ran beside it); passed 3 of 3 alone. The test timed out after 20s waiting for p1's agent to be Idle: 'it was None Unknown', and the screen ended '[1]+  Stopped(SIGTTIN)  .../home/.muster/bin/claude' with a shell prompt under it. So the fake agent was in the background of the pane's shell when it read its terminal, which is a race in how the test starts or resumes the agent, not only slowness. Log: gate-13 of that night's session; the panic is at crates/muster-harness/src/until.rs:113.
title: messaging::a_plain_wait_outlasts_its_agents_next_turn fails under load with its agent stopped by SIGTTIN
